items.hi: मुझे लगता है वह व्यक्ति अपने बच्चे पर बहुत बंदिशें लगाता है।
items.gu: મને લાગે છે કે તે વ્યક્તિ પોતાના બાળક પર બહુ બંધનો મૂકે છે.

opts.hi: उसकी हरकतों पर रोक लगा रहा है
opts.gu: તેની વર્તણૂક પર રોક મૂકે છે

items.why: 束縛 = bind, tie down someone's freedom → 行動を制限している. 自由にさせている is the opposite. The book prints furigana そくばく over 束縛.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: 私は製薬会社で、新しい薬の開発に（ ）している。
items.qr: Watashi wa seiyaku gaisha de, atarashii kusuri no kaihatsu ni ( ) shite iru.
items.en: I work on developing new drugs at a pharmaceutical company.
items.hi: मैं एक दवा कंपनी में नई दवाओं के विकास में लगा हूँ।
items.gu: હું એક દવા કંપનીમાં નવી દવાઓના વિકાસમાં લાગેલો છું.
items.why: 〜に従事する = be engaged in a type of work (農業／研究に従事する). 勤務 takes a place (会社に勤務する), 所属 an organization (営業部に所属する), 在籍 a school or company register — none takes an activity like 開発.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: その大臣のスピーチは、（ ）と1時間も続いた。
items.qr: Sono daijin no supiichi wa, ( ) to ichijikan mo tsuzuita.
items.en: The minister's speech went on and on for a whole hour.
items.hi: उस मंत्री का भाषण पूरे एक घंटे तक खिंचता चला गया।
items.gu: તે મંત્રીનું ભાષણ આખો એક કલાક ખેંચાતું ગયું.
items.why: 延々と続く = drag on and on, usually tiresomely. 続々と is many separate things arriving (続々と集まる); 脈々と is a tradition flowing through generations.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: その部屋はゴミだらけで、足の（ ）もないほどだった。
items.qr: Sono heya wa gomi darake de, ashi no ( ) mo nai hodo datta.
items.en: The room was so full of rubbish there was nowhere to put your feet.
items.hi: कमरा कूड़े से इतना भरा था कि पैर रखने तक की जगह नहीं थी।
items.gu: ઓરડો કચરાથી એટલો ભરેલો હતો કે પગ મૂકવાની પણ જગ્યા નહોતી.
items.why: ⊂⊃ 足の踏み場もない（ほど汚い） (別冊) = so cluttered there's nowhere to step. 踊り場 also has 足-related imagery but means a stair landing.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: 十分睡眠をとったので、今日は頭が（ ）いる。
items.qr: Juubun suimin o totta node, kyou wa atama ga ( ) iru.
items.en: I slept well, so my mind is sharp today.
items.hi: अच्छी नींद ली, इसलिए आज दिमाग़ तेज़ चल रहा है।
items.gu: સારી ઊંઘ લીધી, એટલે આજે મગજ તેજ ચાલે છે.
items.why: 頭がさえる (冴える) = mind is clear and sharp; 目がさえる = can't sleep, wide awake. 頭にくる (with に) means "get angry"; 頭がぼける is the opposite of さえる.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: その選手は、けがによる長い（ ）を感じさせないすばらしい演技をした。
items.qr: Sono senshu wa, kega ni yoru nagai ( ) o kanjisasenai subarashii engi o shita.
items.en: That athlete gave a wonderful performance that showed no sign of the long break caused by injury.
items.hi: उस खिलाड़ी ने ऐसा शानदार प्रदर्शन किया कि चोट के कारण लंबे अंतराल का पता ही नहीं चला।
items.gu: તે ખેલાડીએ એવું શાનદાર પ્રદર્શન કર્યું કે ઈજાને લીધે થયેલા લાંબા અંતરાલનો અહેસાસ જ ન થયો.
items.why: ブランク (blank) in Japanese = a gap in your career or practice: 長いブランク, ブランクを感じさせない. スペース is physical or empty space, not time.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: 父が（ ）に怒っても、兄は謝らなかった。
items.qr: Chichi ga ( ) ni okotte mo, ani wa ayamaranakatta.
items.en: Even though my father was furious, my older brother didn't apologize.
items.hi: पिताजी आग-बबूला हो गए, फिर भी बड़े भाई ने माफ़ी नहीं माँगी।
items.gu: પિતાજી લાલચોળ ગુસ્સે થયા, તોય મોટા ભાઈએ માફી ન માગી.
items.why: かんかんに怒る = be absolutely furious — the same pair seen in 集中⑧ Q3. ごくごく is gulping a drink; ぞくぞく is shivering with cold or excitement.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: 手ごわい
items.qr: tegowai
items.hi: कड़ा, जिसे हराना मुश्किल हो (प्रतिद्वंद्वी, समस्या)
items.gu: કઠિન, જેને હરાવવો મુશ્કેલ હોય (હરીફ, સમસ્યા)

opts.t: この病院での手ごわい看護に感激した。
opts.r: Kono byouin de no tegowai kango ni kangeki shita.
opts.en: (Intended: I was moved by the attentive nursing at this hospital.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: इस अस्पताल की स्नेहपूर्ण देखभाल से मैं भावुक हो गया।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: આ હૉસ્પિટલની ભાવભરી સારસંભાળથી હું ભાવવિભોર થયો.)

opts.t: はじめはうまくいっていたのに、最後に手ごわい失敗をしてしまった。
opts.r: Hajime wa umaku itte ita noni, saigo ni tegowai shippai o shite shimatta.
opts.en: (Intended: It went well at first, but I made a painful mistake at the end.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: शुरू में सब ठीक था, पर आख़िर में भारी ग़लती हो गई।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: શરૂઆતમાં બધું બરાબર હતું, પણ અંતે ભારે ભૂલ થઈ ગઈ.)

opts.t: その社長は手ごわいやり方で、着実に会社を発展させた。
opts.r: Sono shachou wa tegowai yarikata de, chakujitsu ni kaisha o hatten saseta.
opts.en: (Intended: That president grew the company steadily with a sound, safe approach.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: उस अध्यक्ष ने सधे हुए तरीक़े से कंपनी को लगातार आगे बढ़ाया।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: તે પ્રમુખે સધાયેલી રીતે કંપનીને સતત આગળ વધારી.)

opts.t: 試合には勝つことができたが、今までで一番手ごわい相手だった。
opts.r: Shiai ni wa katsu koto ga dekita ga, ima made de ichiban tegowai aite datta.
opts.en: We managed to win the match, but they were the toughest opponents we've ever faced.
opts.hi: मैच तो जीत गए, पर अब तक का सबसे कड़ा प्रतिद्वंद्वी था।
opts.gu: મૅચ તો જીતી ગયા, પણ અત્યાર સુધીનો સૌથી કઠિન હરીફ હતો.

items.why: 手ごわい (手強い) = hard to beat — an opponent or a tough problem. The 別冊: 1 → 手厚い (warm, attentive — 手厚い看護), 2 → 手痛い (painful, costly — 手痛い失敗), 3 → 手堅い (てがたい — solid, safe). Four 手〜い adjectives, four different meanings.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: くつがえす
items.qr: kutsugaesu
items.hi: उलट देना (मान्यता, फ़ैसला)
items.gu: ઉથલાવી દેવું (માન્યતા, ચુકાદો)

opts.t: 彼の発見は、これまでの常識をくつがえすものだった。
opts.r: Kare no hakken wa, kore made no joushiki o kutsugaesu mono datta.
opts.en: His discovery overturned what had been common knowledge until then.
opts.hi: उसकी खोज ने अब तक की आम धारणा को उलट दिया।
opts.gu: તેની શોધે અત્યાર સુધીની સામાન્ય માન્યતાને ઉથલાવી દીધી.

opts.t: 財布を忘れたことに気付いて、駅から家にくつがえした。
opts.r: Saifu o wasureta koto ni kizuite, eki kara ie ni kutsugaeshita.
opts.en: (Intended: Realizing I'd forgotten my wallet, I turned back home from the station.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: बटुआ भूल जाने का पता चला तो स्टेशन से घर लौट आया।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: પાકીટ ભૂલી ગયાનું ધ્યાને આવ્યું તો સ્ટેશનથી ઘરે પાછો ફર્યો.)

opts.t: 小石につまずいて、くつがえしてしまった。
opts.en: (Intended: I tripped on a pebble and fell over.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: कंकड़ से ठोकर खाकर गिर पड़ा।)

opts.t: 父は急に予定をくつがえして出かけていった。
opts.r: Chichi wa kyuu ni yotei o kutsugaeshite dekakete itta.
opts.en: (Intended: My father suddenly changed his plans and went out.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: पिताजी अचानक योजना बदलकर बाहर चले गए।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: પિતાજી અચાનક યોજના બદલીને બહાર નીકળી ગયા.)

items.why: くつがえす (覆す) = overturn something established: 常識／定説／判決をくつがえす. The 別冊: 2 → 引き返した (turned back), 3 → 転んで (fell over), 4 → 変更して (changed plans). A personal change of plans is too small for くつがえす.
items.unit: パワードリル 第28回

items.q: 彼の選択は賢明だったと思う。
items.qr: Kare no sentaku wa kenmei datta to omou.
items.en: I think his choice was a wise one.
items.hi: मुझे लगता है उसका चुनाव समझदारी भरा था।
items.gu: મને લાગે છે કે તેની પસંદગી સમજદારીભરી હતી.
items.why: 賢 = けん (unvoiced; 訓 かしこ(い)) + 明 = めい (not みょう as in 明日 みょうにち). 賢明な判断／選択. Don't confuse with 懸命 けんめい (一生懸命 = with all one's might) — same reading, different kanji.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 旅行先では指示に従って、秩序のある行動をとってください。
items.qr: Ryokousaki de wa shiji ni shitagatte, chitsujo no aru koudou o totte kudasai.
items.en: At your destination, please follow instructions and behave in an orderly way.
items.hi: यात्रा स्थल पर निर्देशों का पालन करें और अनुशासित व्यवहार रखें।
items.gu: પ્રવાસ સ્થળે સૂચનાઓનું પાલન કરો અને શિસ્તબદ્ધ વર્તન રાખો.
items.why: 秩 = ちつ (looks like 失 しつ on the right — that's the しつ trap) + 序 = じょ (short; 順序 じゅんじょ). 社会の秩序を守る.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 人は死を免れることはできない。
items.qr: Hito wa shi o manugareru koto wa dekinai.
items.en: No one can escape death.
items.hi: कोई भी मृत्यु से बच नहीं सकता।
items.gu: કોઈ પણ મૃત્યુથી બચી ન શકે.

opts.t: みちびかれる（導かれる）

items.why: 免 = まぬが(れる) — also read まぬか(れる); 音読み めん (免許 めんきょ, 免除 めんじょ). 責任／被害／死を免れる. 恐れる is the meaning trap (人は死を恐れる is also natural).
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 来月の合唱コンクールに向けて、目下練習中だ。
items.qr: Raigetsu no gasshou konkuuru ni mukete, mokka renshuuchuu da.
items.en: We're currently practising for next month's choir contest.
items.hi: अगले महीने की गायन प्रतियोगिता के लिए फ़िलहाल अभ्यास चल रहा है।
items.gu: આવતા મહિનાની ગાયન સ્પર્ધા માટે હાલ અભ્યાસ ચાલે છે.
items.why: 目下 has two readings with two meanings: もっか = right now (目下練習中, 目下のところ) and めした = one's subordinate (⇔ 目上 めうえ). Here it is a time adverb, so もっか. (もく + か → もっか, with a small っ.)
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: この部屋はとても居心地がいい。
items.qr: Kono heya wa totemo igokochi ga ii.
items.en: This room is very comfortable to be in.
items.hi: यह कमरा बहुत आरामदायक है।
items.gu: આ ઓરડો ખૂબ આરામદાયક છે.
items.why: 居 = い + 心地 ここち, and the first こ voices: いごこち. Compare 着心地 きごこち, 乗り心地 のりごこち, 寝心地 ねごこち — the こ of 心地 always becomes ご in these compounds; the ち never voices.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 祖父の家は、小さな山のふもとにある。
items.qr: Sofu no ie wa, chiisa na yama no fumoto ni aru.
items.en: My grandfather's house is at the foot of a small mountain.
items.hi: दादाजी का घर एक छोटे पहाड़ की तलहटी में है।
items.gu: દાદાજીનું ઘર એક નાના પહાડની તળેટીમાં છે.
items.why: ふもと (麓) = the foot of a mountain → 下の方. ⇔ 頂上 (top). 真ん中 would be 中腹 — tested in 第25回 問題1 Q3.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: しとやかな女性が店に入ってきた。
items.qr: Shitoyaka na josei ga mise ni haitte kita.
items.en: A graceful, refined woman came into the shop.
items.hi: एक शालीन, सौम्य महिला दुकान में आई।
items.gu: એક શાલીન, સૌમ્ય સ્ત્રી દુકાનમાં આવી.
items.why: しとやか (淑やか) = graceful and gentle in manner, said of women → 上品な. It is the opposite of noisy or brash; age has nothing to do with it.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 入学式の日にオリエンテーションがある。
items.u: オリエンテーション / orienteeshon
items.qr: Nyuugakushiki no hi ni orienteeshon ga aru.
items.en: There's an orientation on the day of the entrance ceremony.
items.hi: प्रवेश समारोह के दिन ओरिएंटेशन है।
items.gu: પ્રવેશ સમારંભના દિવસે ઓરિએન્ટેશન છે.
items.why: オリエンテーション = a session explaining rules and procedures to newcomers → 説明会. 歓迎会 is the trap — new students get one too, but it's a party, not a briefing. (ガイダンス in 集中⑪ Q10 is a close cousin.)
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 今のままでは合格はおぼつかない。
items.qr: Ima no mama de wa goukaku wa obotsukanai.
items.en: At this rate, passing looks doubtful.
items.hi: ऐसे ही चलता रहा तो पास होना मुश्किल लगता है।
items.gu: આમ જ ચાલશે તો પાસ થવું શંકાસ્પદ લાગે છે.
items.why: おぼつかない (覚束ない) = doubtful, shaky, unreliable (足元がおぼつかない = unsteady on one's feet) → 可能性が低い. It is uncertainty, not impossibility — 絶対に無理だ is too strong.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: その子はさっきからずっと駄々をこねている。
items.u: 駄々をこねている / dada o konete iru
items.qr: Sono ko wa sakki kara zutto dada o konete iru.
items.en: That child has been throwing a tantrum for a while now.
items.hi: वह बच्चा कब से ज़िद कर रहा है।
items.gu: તે બાળક ક્યારનું જીદ કરે છે.

opts.t: わがままを言っている
ひとりごとを言っている
opts.hi: अपने आप से बात कर रहा है

items.why: 駄々をこねる = (a child) whine and insist on getting their way → わがままを言っている. It is about demands, not violence (あばれる) or anger as such.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: この辺りは工場が（ ）していて空気が悪い。
items.qr: Kono atari wa koujou ga ( ) shite ite kuuki ga warui.
items.en: Factories are packed together around here, so the air is bad.
items.hi: इस इलाक़े में कारख़ाने घने बसे हैं, इसलिए हवा ख़राब है।
items.gu: આ વિસ્તારમાં કારખાનાં ગીચ છે, એટલે હવા ખરાબ છે.
items.why: 工場／家が密集する = be packed closely together (a する-verb of gathering). 過密 is a state noun (過密都市, 過密スケジュール) and doesn't normally take している here; 密着 is close contact (密着取材).
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 姉は何も言わずにじっと私を（ ）いた。
items.qr: Ane wa nani mo iwazu ni jitto watashi o ( ) ita.
items.en: My older sister just glared at me without saying anything.
items.hi: दीदी बिना कुछ कहे मुझे घूरती रहीं।
items.gu: દીદી કંઈ બોલ્યા વગર મને તાકી રહી.
items.why: 何も言わずに rules out every speaking verb (なげく, ぼやく, つぶやく). Only にらむ (glare) takes 私を silently — じっとにらむ.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 本棚にない本の（ ）を希望する場合は、窓口で申し込みが必要です。
items.qr: Hondana ni nai hon no ( ) o kibou suru baai wa, madoguchi de moushikomi ga hitsuyou desu.
items.en: If you want to read a book that isn't on the shelves, you need to apply at the counter.
items.hi: जो किताब शेल्फ़ पर नहीं है, उसे पढ़ना चाहें तो काउंटर पर आवेदन करना होगा।
items.gu: જે પુસ્તક છાજલી પર નથી તે વાંચવું હોય તો કાઉન્ટર પર અરજી કરવી પડશે.
items.why: 閲覧 = inspecting or reading documents and books (閲覧室, 閲覧を希望する). 観覧 is watching a performance or exhibit (観覧車 = Ferris wheel). All end in 覧 "look".
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: （ ）となったら私も手伝うから、まずは自分でやってみなさい。
items.qr: ( ) to nattara watashi mo tetsudau kara, mazu wa jibun de yatte minasai.
items.en: If it comes to the crunch I'll help too, so first try doing it yourself.
items.hi: ज़रूरत पड़ी तो मैं भी मदद करूँगा, इसलिए पहले ख़ुद करके देखो।
items.gu: જરૂર પડશે તો હું પણ મદદ કરીશ, એટલે પહેલાં જાતે કરી જો.
items.why: ⊂⊃ いざとなったら (別冊) = when it really comes to it, in an emergency. Also いざという時 (in a time of need).
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 制限速度を（ ）して、高い罰金をとられてしまった。
items.qr: Seigen sokudo o ( ) shite, takai bakkin o torarete shimatta.
items.en: I went over the speed limit and got hit with a heavy fine.
items.hi: मैंने गति सीमा पार की और भारी जुर्माना भरना पड़ा।
items.gu: મેં ઝડપ મર્યાદા વટાવી અને ભારે દંડ ભરવો પડ્યો.
items.why: 速度／予算／時間をオーバーする = go over a limit. スピードアップ exists, but 制限速度をアップする doesn't — you raise speed, not the limit.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 彼はいつも小声で（ ）話すので、聞き取りにくい。
items.qr: Kare wa itsumo kogoe de ( ) hanasu node, kikitorinikui.
items.en: He always mumbles in a low voice, so he's hard to hear.
items.hi: वह हमेशा धीमी आवाज़ में बुदबुदाकर बोलता है, इसलिए सुनना मुश्किल होता है।
items.gu: તે હંમેશાં ધીમા અવાજે ગણગણીને બોલે છે, એટલે સાંભળવું અઘરું પડે છે.
items.why: ぼそぼそ話す = speak in a low, indistinct mumble — matching 小声 and 聞き取りにくい. The other three are all loud or fast talking.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 当人
items.qr: tounin
items.hi: संबंधित व्यक्ति (जिसके बारे में बात हो रही है)
items.gu: સંબંધિત વ્યક્તિ (જેના વિશે વાત થાય છે)

opts.t: 私当人の考えを述べたいと思う。
opts.r: Watashi tounin no kangae o nobetai to omou.
opts.en: (Intended: I'd like to state my own personal view.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: मैं अपनी निजी राय रखना चाहता हूँ।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: હું મારો પોતાનો અંગત મત રજૂ કરવા માગું છું.)

opts.t: この地区の営業の当人は鈴木さんです。
opts.r: Kono chiku no eigyou no tounin wa Suzuki-san desu.
opts.en: (Intended: The person in charge of sales in this area is Mr Suzuki.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: इस इलाक़े की बिक्री के प्रभारी सुज़ुकी जी हैं।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: આ વિસ્તારના વેચાણના ઇન્ચાર્જ સુઝુકીજી છે.)

opts.t: 当人確認のため、免許証か何か出してください。
opts.r: Tounin kakunin no tame, menkyoshou ka nanika dashite kudasai.
opts.en: (Intended: To confirm your identity, please show your driving licence or similar.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: पहचान की पुष्टि के लिए कृपया ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस या कुछ दिखाइए।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: ઓળખની ખાતરી માટે કૃપા કરીને ડ્રાઇવિંગ લાઇસન્સ કે કંઈક બતાવો.)

opts.t: その噂については、私ではなく、直接当人にきいてほしい。
opts.r: Sono uwasa ni tsuite wa, watashi de wa naku, chokusetsu tounin ni kiite hoshii.
opts.en: About that rumour — please ask the person concerned directly, not me.
opts.hi: उस अफ़वाह के बारे में मुझसे नहीं, सीधे संबंधित व्यक्ति से पूछिए।
opts.gu: એ અફવા વિશે મને નહીં, સીધું સંબંધિત વ્યક્તિને પૂછો.

items.why: 当人 = the very person being discussed, seen from outside (当人同士, 当人の意思). The 別冊: 1 → 自身／個人 (私自身 = myself), 2 → 担当 (person in charge), 3 → 本人 (本人確認 = identity check — the fixed term). The book prints furigana うわさ over 噂.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: めまぐるしい
items.qr: memagurushii
items.hi: चकरा देने वाला, तेज़ी से बदलता
items.gu: ચક્કર લાવી દે એવું, ઝડપથી બદલાતું

opts.t: 毎日、蒸し暑くてめまぐるしい。
opts.en: (Intended: It's hot and humid every day — I feel dizzy.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: रोज़ उमस भरी गर्मी है, सिर चकराता है।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: રોજ ભેજવાળી ગરમી છે, માથું ફરે છે.)

opts.t: 世の中はめまぐるしく変化している。
opts.r: Yo no naka wa memagurushiku henka shite iru.
opts.en: The world is changing at a dizzying pace.
opts.hi: दुनिया चकरा देने वाली रफ़्तार से बदल रही है।
opts.gu: દુનિયા ચક્કર લાવી દે એવી ઝડપે બદલાઈ રહી છે.

opts.t: この計画はめまぐるしく考えられた。
opts.en: (Intended: This plan was thought out very carefully.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: यह योजना बहुत सोच-समझकर बनाई गई।)

opts.t: 会社の人間関係がめまぐるしくて大変だ。
opts.r: Kaisha no ningen kankei ga memagurushikute taihen da.
opts.en: (Intended: Relationships at work are complicated and hard to deal with.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: दफ़्तर के आपसी रिश्ते उलझे हुए हैं, बड़ी मुश्किल है।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: ઑફિસના આંતરિક સંબંધો ગૂંચવાયેલા છે, બહુ મુશ્કેલી છે.)

items.why: The 別冊 gives the rule: 「めまぐるしい」は変化や動きをともなうことに使う — it is used for things involving change or movement (めまぐるしく変わる, めまぐるしい一日). Weather (1), careful thinking (3) and complicated relationships (4 — ややこしい／複雑) have no rapid movement. The kanji is 目まぐるしい: so fast your eyes spin.
items.unit: パワードリル 第29回

items.q: 十分に練習し、自信を持って試合に臨んだ。
items.qr: Juubun ni renshuu shi, jishin o motte shiai ni nozonda.
items.en: Having practised enough, I went into the match with confidence.
items.hi: पूरा अभ्यास करके मैं आत्मविश्वास के साथ मैच में उतरा।
items.gu: પૂરતો અભ્યાસ કરીને હું આત્મવિશ્વાસ સાથે મૅચમાં ઊતર્યો.
items.why: 臨 = のぞ(む) (音読み りん: 臨時 りんじ). 試合／試験／会議に臨む = face, take part in. 挑む いどむ is the meaning trap — "take on a challenge" — and also fits 試合に, but the kanji 臨 is のぞむ. (望む is another のぞむ: "to hope".)
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 震度6の大地震がその地域を襲った。
items.qr: Shindo roku no daijishin ga sono chiiki o osotta.
items.en: A major earthquake of seismic intensity 6 struck the area.
items.hi: तीव्रता 6 का बड़ा भूकंप उस इलाक़े में आया।
items.gu: તીવ્રતા 6નો મોટો ભૂકંપ એ વિસ્તારમાં ત્રાટક્યો.
items.why: 襲 = おそ(う) (音読み しゅう: 襲撃 しゅうげき). 地震／台風／不安が襲う. 揺すった is the meaning trap for an earthquake, but it is the kanji 揺 (ゆ).
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 彼はとてもまじめでいい人だが、融通がきかない。
items.qr: Kare wa totemo majime de ii hito da ga, yuuzuu ga kikanai.
items.en: He's very earnest and a nice person, but he's inflexible.
items.hi: वह बहुत ईमानदार और अच्छा इंसान है, पर लचीला नहीं है।
items.gu: તે ખૂબ નિષ્ઠાવાન અને સારો માણસ છે, પણ લવચીક નથી.

opts.en: (not a word; cf. 憂鬱 ゆううつ)

items.why: 融 = ゆう + 通 = ずう (a rare reading — normally つう as in 交通). 融通がきく／きかない = (in)flexible; お金を融通する = lend money. The voiced ずう with a long vowel is the whole test.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 彼はインタビューの間、終始不機嫌な様子だった。
items.qr: Kare wa intabyuu no aida, shuushi fukigen na yousu datta.
items.en: Throughout the interview, he seemed in a bad mood from start to finish.
items.hi: पूरे इंटरव्यू के दौरान वह शुरू से आख़िर तक नाराज़ दिखा।
items.gu: આખા ઇન્ટરવ્યૂ દરમિયાન તે શરૂથી અંત સુધી નારાજ દેખાયો.
items.why: 終 = しゅう + 始 = し (unvoiced). 終始 = all the way through (終始一貫 = consistent throughout). 従事 じゅうじ was the answer in 第28回 問題3 Q1 — a nice cross-check.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 公演が大成功に終わって、感無量だ。
items.qr: Kouen ga daiseikou ni owatte, kanmuryou da.
items.en: The performance ended in great success — I'm overwhelmed with emotion.
items.hi: प्रस्तुति बड़ी सफलता से समाप्त हुई, मैं भावविभोर हूँ।
items.gu: રજૂઆત મોટી સફળતાથી પૂરી થઈ, હું ભાવવિભોર છું.
items.why: 感 = かん + 無 = む (not ぶ as in 無事 ぶじ) + 量 = りょう (not りゅう). Literally "feelings beyond measure". Two checks: む vs ぶ, りょう vs りゅう.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 何度返されても、しぶとく企画書を出し続けた。
items.qr: Nando kaesarete mo, shibutoku kikakusho o dashitsuzuketa.
items.en: However many times it was sent back, I doggedly kept submitting the proposal.
items.hi: कितनी भी बार लौटाया गया, मैं डटकर प्रस्ताव जमा करता रहा।
items.gu: કેટલીય વાર પાછું આવ્યું, છતાં હું અડગ રહીને પ્રસ્તાવ આપતો રહ્યો.
items.why: しぶとい = stubbornly persistent, refusing to give up → ねばり強く (seen in 第25回 as a 別冊 → word). 何度返されても makes persistence the point. The book prints furigana ていねい over 丁寧.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: この絵は白と黒のコントラストがすばらしい。
items.qr: Kono e wa shiro to kuro no kontorasuto ga subarashii.
items.en: The contrast between black and white in this painting is superb.
items.hi: इस चित्र में सफ़ेद और काले का विरोधाभास शानदार है।
items.gu: આ ચિત્રમાં સફેદ અને કાળાનો વિરોધાભાસ શાનદાર છે.
items.why: コントラスト = contrast → 対比. 調和 (harmony) is the trap — praising a picture's harmony is natural too, but harmony is the opposite of contrast.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 刑事の追及にたじろいだ彼は、ついに罪を認めた。
items.qr: Keiji no tsuikyuu ni tajiroida kare wa, tsui ni tsumi o mitometa.
items.en: Flinching under the detective's questioning, he finally admitted his crime.
items.hi: जासूस की कड़ी पूछताछ से घबराकर उसने आख़िरकार अपराध मान लिया।
items.gu: ડિટેક્ટિવની સખત પૂછપરછથી ડગી જઈને તેણે આખરે ગુનો કબૂલ્યો.
items.why: たじろぐ = flinch, recoil, lose your nerve in the face of pressure → 圧倒された. The other three are physical defeat or destruction — and 倒壊 is for buildings.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 飲酒運転による事故は後を絶たない。
items.u: 後を絶たない / ato o tatanai
items.qr: Inshu unten ni yoru jiko wa ato o tatanai.
items.en: Accidents caused by drunk driving never stop happening.
items.hi: शराब पीकर गाड़ी चलाने से होने वाली दुर्घटनाएँ थमती ही नहीं।
items.gu: દારૂ પીને ગાડી ચલાવવાથી થતા અકસ્માતો અટકતા જ નથી.

opts.hi: एक के बाद एक होते हैं

items.why: 後を絶たない = the trail never ends → keeps happening, 次々起きる. 絶たない looks negative, which makes 最近は起きない the trap — but the phrase means the opposite.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: あの人の気まぐれはいつものことなので慣れている。
items.qr: Ano hito no kimagure wa itsumo no koto na node narete iru.
items.en: That person's fickleness is nothing new, so I'm used to it.
items.hi: उस व्यक्ति की मनमौजी आदत हमेशा की बात है, इसलिए मुझे आदत हो गई है।
items.gu: તે વ્યક્તિનો મનમોજી સ્વભાવ રોજની વાત છે, એટલે મને ટેવ પડી ગઈ છે.

opts.t: 気分が変わりやすいこと

items.why: 気まぐれ = whimsical, moods and plans changing on a whim → 気分が変わりやすいこと. 気まぐれな天気 = changeable weather.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 政府は（ ）となっている税金問題について、来週中に方針を示す予定だ。
items.qr: Seifu wa ( ) to natte iru zeikin mondai ni tsuite, raishuuchuu ni houshin o shimesu yotei da.
items.en: The government plans to set out its policy next week on the tax issue that has been pending.
items.hi: सरकार लंबित कर-मुद्दे पर अगले हफ़्ते अपनी नीति बताने वाली है।
items.gu: સરકાર બાકી રહેલા કર-મુદ્દા પર આવતા અઠવાડિયે પોતાની નીતિ જાહેર કરવાની છે.
items.why: 懸案 (けんあん) = an issue that has been hanging unresolved: 懸案となっている／長年の懸案. 懸念 (けねん) shares 懸 but means "worry" (懸念を示す); 議案 and 法案 are documents put before parliament. The book prints furigana over 懸案 and 懸念.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 期間延長の案に対して、出席者から（ ）が出た。
items.qr: Kikan enchou no an ni taishite, shussekisha kara ( ) ga deta.
items.en: Objections were raised by those present to the proposal to extend the period.
items.hi: अवधि बढ़ाने के प्रस्ताव पर उपस्थित लोगों ने आपत्ति जताई।
items.gu: મુદત વધારવાના પ્રસ્તાવ સામે હાજર લોકોએ વાંધો ઉઠાવ્યો.
items.why: 案に対して異論が出る = an objection to a proposal is raised (異論はない = no objection). 議論 is the whole discussion, not a single objection; 口論 is a personal quarrel.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: そこにいた人たちは皆、（ ）音楽にあわせて踊った。
items.qr: Soko ni ita hitotachi wa mina, ( ) ongaku ni awasete odotta.
items.en: Everyone there danced to the light, lively music.
items.hi: वहाँ मौजूद सब लोग हल्के-फुल्के, जोशीले संगीत पर नाचे।
items.gu: ત્યાં હાજર બધા લોકો હળવા, ઉત્સાહભર્યા સંગીત પર નાચ્યા.
items.why: 軽快な音楽／リズム／足取り = light and bouncy. 軽率 was tested in 第25回 問題4 Q1 (rash behaviour); 気軽 and 手軽 describe how easy something is to do, not how music sounds.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: オリンピックを目指し、ひたすら練習に（ ）。
items.qr: Orinpikku o mezashi, hitasura renshuu ni ( ).
items.en: Aiming for the Olympics, I threw myself single-mindedly into training.
items.hi: ओलंपिक के लक्ष्य से मैं पूरी लगन से अभ्यास में जुट गया।
items.gu: ઑલિમ્પિકના લક્ષ્ય સાથે હું પૂરી લગનથી અભ્યાસમાં લાગી ગયો.
items.why: 〜に打ち込む = throw yourself into an activity (仕事／研究に打ち込む). たたき込む is drilling knowledge into someone (頭にたたき込む) and takes を.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: この事実は口が（ ）も言えない。
items.qr: Kono jijitsu wa kuchi ga ( ) mo ienai.
items.en: I couldn't reveal this fact even if my life depended on it.
items.hi: यह बात मैं मर जाऊँ तो भी नहीं बताऊँगा।
items.gu: આ વાત હું મરી જાઉં તોય નહીં કહું.
items.why: ⊂⊃ 口が裂けても（言えない） (別冊) = "even if my mouth were torn apart" — I will never tell. 破れる also means "tear" but is for paper and cloth; the idiom is fixed with 裂ける. The book prints furigana さ over 裂.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 年をとると、新聞などの小さい字が（ ）、見えにくくなる。
items.qr: Toshi o toru to, shinbun nado no chiisai ji ga ( ), mienikuku naru.
items.en: As you get older, small print in newspapers becomes blurry and hard to see.
items.hi: उम्र बढ़ने पर अख़बार जैसे छोटे अक्षर धुँधले दिखने लगते हैं और पढ़ना मुश्किल होता है।
items.gu: ઉંમર વધતાં છાપાં જેવા નાના અક્ષરો ઝાંખા દેખાય છે અને વાંચવા અઘરા બને છે.
items.why: 字／景色／記憶がぼやける = go blurry, out of focus — and 見えにくくなる confirms it. とろける is melting (cheese, ice cream); くだける is shattering or a casual style (くだけた言い方).
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: うっとり
items.qr: uttori
items.hi: मंत्रमुग्ध होकर
items.gu: મંત્રમુગ્ધ થઈને

opts.t: しまった！ 妻の誕生日をうっとり忘れていた。
opts.r: Shimatta! Tsuma no tanjoubi o uttori wasurete ita.
opts.en: (Intended: Oh no! I completely forgot my wife's birthday.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: अरे नहीं! पत्नी का जन्मदिन बिल्कुल भूल गया।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: અરે! પત્નીનો જન્મદિવસ સાવ ભૂલી ગયો.)

opts.t: もう少し時間をかけてうっとり考えてから、お返事します。
opts.r: Mou sukoshi jikan o kakete uttori kangaete kara, ohenji shimasu.
opts.en: (Intended: I'll take a bit more time to think it over carefully, then reply.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: थोड़ा और समय लेकर अच्छी तरह सोचकर जवाब दूँगा।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: થોડો વધુ સમય લઈને સારી રીતે વિચારીને જવાબ આપીશ.)

opts.t: その俳優が舞台に現れると、女性たちはうっとり見つめた。
opts.r: Sono haiyuu ga butai ni arawareru to, joseitachi wa uttori mitsumeta.
opts.en: When the actor appeared on stage, the women gazed at him spellbound.
opts.hi: वह अभिनेता मंच पर आया तो महिलाएँ उसे मंत्रमुग्ध होकर देखती रहीं।
opts.gu: તે અભિનેતા મંચ પર આવ્યો ત્યારે સ્ત્રીઓ તેને મંત્રમુગ્ધ થઈને જોતી રહી.

opts.t: こちらのシャンプーで洗うと、髪がうっとりしますよ。
opts.r: Kochira no shanpuu de arau to, kami ga uttori shimasu yo.
opts.en: (Intended: Wash with this shampoo and your hair will feel moist and silky.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: इस शैम्पू से धोने पर बाल मुलायम और नम रहेंगे।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: આ શૅમ્પૂથી ધોવાથી વાળ મુલાયમ અને ભેજવાળા રહેશે.)

items.why: うっとり = carried away by beauty or pleasure (うっとり見つめる／聞き入る). The 別冊: 1 → うっかり (carelessly forgot), 2 → じっくり (thoroughly, taking time), 4 → しっとり (moist, silky). Four 〜っとり／〜っくり mimetics that only differ in one or two kana.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 根深い
items.qr: nebukai
items.hi: गहरी जड़ों वाला (समस्या, अविश्वास)
items.gu: ઊંડાં મૂળવાળું (સમસ્યા, અવિશ્વાસ)

opts.t: 木を植えるために根深い穴を掘った。
opts.r: Ki o ueru tame ni nebukai ana o hotta.
opts.en: (Intended: I dug a deep hole to plant a tree.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: पेड़ लगाने के लिए गहरा गड्ढा खोदा।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: ઝાડ વાવવા માટે ઊંડો ખાડો ખોદ્યો.)

opts.t: この問題は根深いので、簡単には解決できない。
opts.r: Kono mondai wa nebukai node, kantan ni wa kaiketsu dekinai.
opts.en: This problem is deep-rooted, so it can't be solved easily.
opts.hi: यह समस्या गहरी जड़ों वाली है, इसलिए आसानी से हल नहीं होगी।
opts.gu: આ સમસ્યા ઊંડાં મૂળવાળી છે, એટલે સહેલાઈથી ઉકેલાશે નહીં.

opts.t: では、ここに座って、根深く息を吸ってください。
opts.r: Dewa, koko ni suwatte, nebukaku iki o sutte kudasai.
opts.en: (Intended: Now sit here and breathe in deeply.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: अब यहाँ बैठिए और गहरी साँस लीजिए।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: હવે અહીં બેસો અને ઊંડો શ્વાસ લો.)

opts.t: 話が難しすぎて、あまり根深くは理解できなかった。
opts.r: Hanashi ga muzukashisugite, amari nebukaku wa rikai dekinakatta.
opts.en: (Intended: The talk was too difficult, so I couldn't understand it very deeply.)
opts.hi: (इरादा: बात बहुत कठिन थी, इसलिए गहराई से समझ नहीं पाया।)
opts.gu: (ઇરાદો: વાત બહુ અઘરી હતી, એટલે ઊંડાણથી સમજી ન શક્યો.)

items.why: 根深い is figurative: a problem or feeling whose roots go deep (根深い対立／不信感). The 別冊: 1 → 深い, 3 → 深く, 4 → 深く — plain 深い for physical depth, breathing and understanding. Compare 根強い in 第25回.
items.unit: パワードリル 第30回

items.q: 美術館はこの絵に3億円の保険を（ a いれた ／ b かけた ）そうだ。
items.qr: Bijutsukan wa kono e ni san-oku-en no hoken o (a ireta / b kaketa) sou da.
items.en: I hear the museum has insured this painting for 300 million yen.
items.hi: सुना है संग्रहालय ने इस चित्र का 30 करोड़ येन का बीमा करवाया है।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે સંગ્રહાલયે આ ચિત્રનો 30 કરોડ યેનનો વીમો ઉતરાવ્યો છે.

opts.en: put in — not used with 保険を
opts.hi: डाला — 保険を के साथ नहीं

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The fixed collocation is 〜に保険をかける "insure something". If you are the one joining a policy, you say 保険に入る (intransitive, with に). 保険をいれる mixes the two and is not used.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: もうすぐパスポートの有効期限が（ a きれる ／ b なくなる ）。
items.qr: Mou sugu pasupooto no yuukou kigen ga (a kireru / b nakunaru).
items.en: My passport is about to expire.
items.hi: मेरे पासपोर्ट की वैधता जल्द ही ख़त्म होने वाली है।
items.gu: મારા પાસપોર્ટની મુદત ટૂંક સમયમાં પૂરી થવાની છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A deadline or validity period "runs out" with 切れる: 期限／契約／賞味期限が切れる. なくなる is for things that get used up or lost (お金がなくなる), not for a date passing.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 家に入る前に、靴の汚れを（ a おとした ／ b はずした ）。
items.qr: Ie ni hairu mae ni, kutsu no yogore o (a otoshita / b hazushita).
items.en: Before going into the house, I cleaned the dirt off my shoes.
items.hi: घर में घुसने से पहले मैंने जूतों की गंदगी साफ़ की।
items.gu: ઘરમાં પ્રવેશતાં પહેલાં મેં જોડાંનો મેલ સાફ કર્યો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Dirt, stains and make-up are "dropped" off: 汚れ／化粧／泥を落とす. 外す is for objects fastened on (眼鏡／ボタン／席を外す).
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 3時間にわたる熱戦の末、ようやく勝負が（ a きいた ／ b ついた ）。
items.qr: Sanjikan ni wataru nessen no sue, youyaku shoubu ga (a kiita / b tsuita).
items.en: After a fierce three-hour battle, the match was finally decided.
items.hi: तीन घंटे चली कड़ी टक्कर के बाद आख़िरकार हार-जीत का फ़ैसला हुआ।
items.gu: ત્રણ કલાક ચાલેલી જોરદાર ટક્કર પછી આખરે હારજીતનો ફેંસલો થયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A contest being settled = 勝負／決着／けりがつく. きく ("take effect") goes with medicine or a strategy (作戦が効いた), not with the match itself.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 金利が低いので、貯金をしてもほとんど利息が（ a きかない ／ b つかない ）。
items.qr: Kinri ga hikui node, chokin o shite mo hotondo risoku ga (a kikanai / b tsukanai).
items.en: Interest rates are low, so even if you save you earn almost no interest.
items.hi: ब्याज दरें कम हैं, इसलिए बचत करने पर भी लगभग कोई ब्याज नहीं मिलता।
items.gu: વ્યાજદર ઓછા છે, એટલે બચત કરવા છતાં લગભગ કોઈ વ્યાજ મળતું નથી.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Interest is "attached" to your savings: 利息／利子がつく. Same verb as Q4, but here つく means "be added", not "be settled".
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 水で冷やしたら、少し痛みが（ a とんで ／ b ひいて ）きた。
items.qr: Mizu de hiyashitara, sukoshi itami ga (a tonde / b hiite) kita.
items.en: When I cooled it with water, the pain eased a little.
items.hi: पानी से ठंडा करने पर दर्द थोड़ा कम हो गया।
items.gu: પાણીથી ઠંડું કર્યું તો દુખાવો થોડો ઓછો થયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Pain, fever, swelling and floodwater "draw back": 痛み／熱／腫れ／水が引く. 〜てきた adds "gradually". 飛ぶ appears only in the children's charm 痛いの痛いの飛んでいけ, not in normal description.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 家庭を（ a つくる ／ b もつ ）と責任感がわいてくる。
items.qr: Katei o (a tsukuru / b motsu) to sekininkan ga waite kuru.
items.en: Once you have a family of your own, a sense of responsibility develops.
items.hi: अपना घर-परिवार बसाने पर ज़िम्मेदारी का एहसास पैदा होता है।
items.gu: પોતાનો ઘરસંસાર માંડો એટલે જવાબદારીની ભાવના જાગે છે.

opts.en: have (家庭を持つ = have one's own family)

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 家庭を持つ is the set phrase for marrying and having your own household; the condition 〜と (whenever / once) describes that life change. 家庭をつくる does exist ("create a [happy] home", e.g. 明るい家庭をつくる), but it describes building the atmosphere of a home, so b is the better fit for "once you have a family".
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 社長にお酒を（ a ついで ／ b つけて ）いただいて恐縮した。
items.qr: Shachou ni osake o (a tsuide / b tsukete) itadaite kyoushuku shita.
items.en: I felt very humbled when the company president poured sake for me.
items.hi: जब अध्यक्ष ने ख़ुद मेरे लिए साके डाली तो मैं बहुत संकोच में पड़ गया।
items.gu: પ્રમુખે જાતે મારા માટે સાકે રેડી ત્યારે મને ખૂબ સંકોચ થયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Pouring a drink into someone's glass = 注ぐ (つぐ), te-form ついで — easy to confuse with ついで "on the way" (次いで). お酒をつける means heating sake (熱燗をつける), not pouring it into your glass.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 彼は王の血を（ a とる ／ b ひく ）家に生まれた。
items.qr: Kare wa ou no chi o (a toru / b hiku) ie ni umareta.
items.en: He was born into a family descended from royalty.
items.hi: उसका जन्म राजवंश से जुड़े परिवार में हुआ।
items.gu: તેનો જન્મ રાજવંશ સાથે જોડાયેલા કુટુંબમાં થયો.

opts.en: take (血をとる = take a blood sample)

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Inheriting someone's bloodline = 〜の血を引く. 血をとる is a medical blood test. (The readable end of the page-foot answers, 「…b 10 a」, agrees with b here.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: この薬は、食後しばらく時間を（ a おいて ／ b かけて ）から飲んでください。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa, shokugo shibaraku jikan o (a oite / b kakete) kara nonde kudasai.
items.en: Please take this medicine a little while after eating.
items.hi: यह दवा खाने के कुछ देर बाद लें।
items.gu: આ દવા જમ્યા પછી થોડી વાર રહીને લો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 時間をおく／間をおく = let some time pass before doing the next thing. 時間をかける is spending a long time on an activity (時間をかけて読む) — nothing is being done here, you are just waiting. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング①

items.q: 田中さんが車に（ a おされて ／ b ひかれて ）入院したそうだ。
items.qr: Tanaka-san ga kuruma ni (a osarete / b hikarete) nyuuin shita sou da.
items.en: I hear Mr Tanaka was hit by a car and is in hospital.
items.hi: सुना है तानाका जी गाड़ी की चपेट में आ गए और अस्पताल में भर्ती हैं।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે તાનાકા સાહેબ ગાડીની અડફેટે આવી ગયા અને હૉસ્પિટલમાં દાખલ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A vehicle hitting a person = 車にひかれる (轢かれる, passive of 轢く) — or 車にはねられる when thrown by the impact. 押される is being pushed by a person or crowd, not a car accident.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 未成年でも銀行口座を（ a あける ／ b ひらく ）ことはできますか。
items.qr: Miseinen demo ginkou kouza o (a akeru / b hiraku) koto wa dekimasu ka.
items.en: Can a minor open a bank account?
items.hi: क्या नाबालिग भी बैंक खाता खोल सकता है?
items.gu: શું સગીર પણ બેંક ખાતું ખોલી શકે?

opts.en: open, start (an account, a shop, a meeting)

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Both verbs are written 開, but 開く (ひらく) is used for starting something new: 口座／店／会議／パーティーを開く. 開ける (あける) is for physically opening a door, window or box.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 実力が違いすぎて、10点以上差が（ a あって ／ b ついて ）しまった。
items.qr: Jitsuryoku ga chigaisugite, juutten ijou sa ga (a atte / b tsuite) shimatta.
items.en: Our abilities were so different that the gap ended up at more than 10 points.
items.hi: क़ाबिलियत में इतना फ़र्क़ था कि 10 से ज़्यादा अंकों का अंतर हो गया।
items.gu: ક્ષમતામાં એટલો ફરક હતો કે 10થી વધુ પૉઇન્ટનું અંતર પડી ગયું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A gap that opens during a game = 差がつく (transitive 差をつける "pull ahead"). 〜てしまった marks a change that happened, which suits つく; ある only states that a difference exists.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 私はここ数年ずっとA新聞を（ a とっている ／ b もっている ）。
items.qr: Watashi wa koko suunen zutto Ee-shinbun o (a totte iru / b motte iru).
items.en: I've been taking Newspaper A for the last few years.
items.hi: मैं पिछले कुछ सालों से A अख़बार लगवाता हूँ।
items.gu: હું છેલ્લાં થોડાં વર્ષથી A છાપું બંધાવું છું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Having a newspaper delivered regularly = 新聞をとる (also 雑誌をとる). ここ数年ずっと points to a continuing subscription. 持っている would just mean holding a copy.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: ワイシャツにアイロンを（ a かける ／ b すべる ）のはけっこう難しい。
items.qr: Waishatsu ni airon o (a kakeru / b suberu) no wa kekkou muzukashii.
items.en: Ironing a dress shirt is quite difficult.
items.hi: शर्ट पर इस्त्री करना काफ़ी मुश्किल है।
items.gu: શર્ટ પર ઇસ્ત્રી કરવી ઘણી અઘરી છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 〜にアイロンをかける is the fixed phrase (like 掃除機をかける "vacuum"). 滑る is intransitive, so it can't take アイロンを. The iron does slide over the shirt, which is what makes b tempting.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 家族を（ a 育てる ／ b 養う ）ために、どんな仕事でもしようと思った。
items.qr: Kazoku o (a sodateru / b yashinau) tame ni, donna shigoto demo shiyou to omotta.
items.en: I decided I'd take any job to support my family.
items.hi: परिवार का पेट पालने के लिए मैंने कोई भी काम करने की ठानी।
items.gu: કુટુંબનું ભરણપોષણ કરવા મેં કોઈ પણ કામ કરવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Earning money to keep a household going = 家族を養う; the どんな仕事でも ("any job") clause is about money. 育てる means bringing up children or plants, and you don't "raise" your whole family (including a spouse).
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 友達が来るまで、本屋で時間を（ a 倒した ／ b つぶした ）。
items.qr: Tomodachi ga kuru made, honya de jikan o (a taoshita / b tsubushita).
items.en: I killed time in a bookshop until my friend arrived.
items.hi: दोस्त के आने तक मैंने किताबों की दुकान में समय काटा।
items.gu: મિત્ર આવે ત્યાં સુધી મેં પુસ્તકની દુકાનમાં સમય પસાર કર્યો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 時間をつぶす "crush time" = kill time while waiting (noun 暇つぶし). 倒す (knock over, defeat) doesn't combine with 時間.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: この問題について、早急に結論を（ a 出す ／ b つける ）べきだ。
items.qr: Kono mondai ni tsuite, soukyuu ni ketsuron o (a dasu / b tsukeru) beki da.
items.en: We should reach a conclusion on this issue as soon as possible.
items.hi: इस मुद्दे पर जल्द से जल्द निष्कर्ष निकालना चाहिए।
items.gu: આ મુદ્દે બને તેટલી જલદી નિષ્કર્ષ કાઢવો જોઈએ.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 結論を出す／結論が出る is the standard pair (also 答えを出す). つける goes with 決着／けり／見当をつける — close in meaning, which is the trap, but 結論をつける is not the natural collocation.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: 飛行機が着陸する前に、時計を現地の時刻に（ a 合わせた ／ b そろえた ）。
items.qr: Hikouki ga chakuriku suru mae ni, tokei o genchi no jikoku ni (a awaseta / b soroeta).
items.en: Before the plane landed, I set my watch to local time.
items.hi: विमान उतरने से पहले मैंने घड़ी स्थानीय समय से मिला ली।
items.gu: વિમાન ઊતરે તે પહેલાં મેં ઘડિયાળ સ્થાનિક સમય મુજબ મેળવી લીધી.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Adjusting one thing to match a standard = A を B に合わせる (時計を時刻に／予定を相手に合わせる). そろえる makes several things the same as each other (靴をそろえる, 長さをそろえる). (The readable page-foot fragment 「9 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: みんなから「がんばって」「期待しているよ」と言われ、ますますプレッシャーが（ a かかった ／ b のった ）。
items.qr: Minna kara "ganbatte" "kitai shite iru yo" to iware, masumasu puresshaa ga (a kakatta / b notta).
items.en: Everyone told me "Good luck!" and "We're counting on you!", which put me under even more pressure.
items.hi: सबने "शुभकामनाएँ" और "तुमसे उम्मीद है" कहा, जिससे मुझ पर और भी दबाव पड़ गया।
items.gu: બધાએ "શુભેચ્છા" અને "તારી પાસે આશા છે" કહ્યું, એટલે મારા પર વધુ દબાણ આવ્યું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Pressure "hangs" on you: プレッシャー／負担／圧力がかかる (transitive: 〜にプレッシャーをかける). のる is the trap because a weight "rests on" your shoulders in English, but のる doesn't go with プレッシャー. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング②

items.q: （ a 耳を貸す ／ b 耳をすます ）と、虫の声が聞こえる。もう秋だ。
items.qr: (a Mimi o kasu / b Mimi o sumasu) to, mushi no koe ga kikoeru. Mou aki da.
items.en: If you listen carefully, you can hear the insects singing. It's autumn already.
items.hi: कान लगाकर सुनो तो कीड़ों की आवाज़ सुनाई देती है। शरद ऋतु आ गई।
items.gu: કાન માંડીને સાંભળો તો જીવજંતુઓનો અવાજ સંભળાય છે. પાનખર આવી ગઈ.

opts.hi: किसी की बात पर कान देना

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 耳を澄ます is focusing your hearing on a faint sound — insects, footsteps, distant music. 耳を貸す is about paying attention to what a person says or asks (相談に耳を貸す), mostly in the negative (耳を貸さない), so it doesn't fit insects.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: あの学生の授業中の態度は、（ a 目にあまる ／ b 目に浮かぶ ）ものがある。
items.qr: Ano gakusei no jugyouchuu no taido wa, (a me ni amaru / b me ni ukabu) mono ga aru.
items.en: That student's behaviour in class is beyond what can be tolerated.
items.hi: उस छात्र का कक्षा में रवैया हद से ज़्यादा ख़राब है।
items.gu: તે વિદ્યાર્થીનું વર્ગમાંનું વર્તન હદ બહારનું છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 目に余る = more than the eye can take, so bad that you can't ignore it — used for behaviour; 〜は目に余るものがある is a standard pattern. 目に浮かぶ is imagining a scene (喜ぶ顔が目に浮かぶ) and doesn't evaluate behaviour.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 初めて見たかわいい孫の姿に、祖父母は（ a 目を細めた ／ b 目をつぶった ）。
items.qr: Hajimete mita kawaii mago no sugata ni, sofubo wa (a me o hosometa / b me o tsubutta).
items.en: Seeing their sweet grandchild for the first time, the grandparents beamed with delight.
items.hi: प्यारे पोते-पोती को पहली बार देखकर दादा-दादी ख़ुशी से मुस्कुरा उठे।
items.gu: વહાલા પૌત્ર-પૌત્રીને પહેલી વાર જોઈને દાદા-દાદી આનંદથી મલકાઈ ઊઠ્યાં.

opts.en: closed their eyes; turned a blind eye
opts.gu: આંખો મીંચી; આંખ આડા કાન કર્યા

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 目を細める = to narrow your eyes in a smile of tenderness — the classic expression of grandparents with a grandchild. 目をつぶる means either literally closing your eyes or overlooking a fault, and neither fits this happy first meeting.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 新大統領が誕生したA国の情勢から（ a 目が離せない ／ b 目も当てられない ）。
items.qr: Shin-daitouryou ga tanjou shita A-koku no jousei kara (a me ga hanasenai / b me mo aterarenai).
items.en: I can't take my eyes off the situation in Country A now that it has a new president.
items.hi: नए राष्ट्रपति वाले देश A की स्थिति से नज़र हटाना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: નવા રાષ્ટ્રપ્રમુખવાળા દેશ A ની પરિસ્થિતિ પરથી નજર હટાવવી મુશ્કેલ છે.

opts.en: can't look away, must keep watching

opts.hi: इतना बुरा कि देखा न जाए
opts.gu: એટલું ખરાબ કે જોઈ ન શકાય

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The particle から goes with 目が離せない: 〜から目が離せない "can't take one's eyes off ~" (an unfolding situation, a child, a match). 目も当てられない describes something already in a dreadful state (目も当てられない有様) and doesn't take から; a new president alone isn't a disaster.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 最近友人が禁煙を始めたと聞いて、愛煙家の私は（ a 耳が遠い ／ b 耳が痛い ）。
items.qr: Saikin yuujin ga kin'en o hajimeta to kiite, aienka no watashi wa (a mimi ga tooi / b mimi ga itai).
items.en: Hearing that my friend has given up smoking stings a bit, as I'm a keen smoker.
items.hi: दोस्त ने सिगरेट छोड़ दी, यह सुनकर मुझ जैसे सिगरेट-प्रेमी को बात चुभती है।
items.gu: મિત્રે સિગારેટ છોડી દીધી એ સાંભળીને મારા જેવા સિગારેટ-પ્રેમીને વાત ખૂંચે છે.

opts.en: it hurts to hear (it applies to me)

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 耳が痛い = what you hear is uncomfortable because it points at your own weak spot. A heavy smoker hearing that a friend has quit feels exactly that. 耳が遠い is a physical hearing problem, which has nothing to do with being a smoker.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 貸したお金は来月の末までに（ a 耳をそろえて ／ b 耳をかたむけて ）返してください。
items.qr: Kashita okane wa raigetsu no sue made ni (a mimi o soroete / b mimi o katamukete) kaeshite kudasai.
items.en: Please pay back the money I lent you in full by the end of next month.
items.hi: जो पैसे उधार दिए हैं, वे अगले महीने के अंत तक पूरे के पूरे लौटा दीजिए।
items.gu: ઉછીના આપેલા પૈસા આવતા મહિનાના અંત સુધીમાં પૂરેપૂરા પાછા આપજો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 耳をそろえて返す／払う = repay the whole amount without missing anything (耳 here is the edge of an old gold coin, and you "line up the edges" of a full stack). 耳を傾ける is attentive listening, which has nothing to do with paying.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: （ a 長い目 ／ b 白い目 ）で見たら、借りるより買ったほうが得かもしれない。
items.qr: (a Nagai me / b Shiroi me) de mitara, kariru yori katta hou ga toku kamo shirenai.
items.en: In the long run, buying might work out cheaper than renting.
items.hi: लंबे समय के हिसाब से देखें तो किराये से बेहतर ख़रीदना फ़ायदेमंद हो सकता है।
items.gu: લાંબા ગાળાની દૃષ્ટિએ જોઈએ તો ભાડે લેવા કરતાં ખરીદવું ફાયદાકારક હોઈ શકે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 長い目で見る = judge over a long period, not by the immediate cost — exactly the reasoning about buying vs renting. 白い目で見る is looking at a person with contempt, and its object is always a person.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 吉田さんは甘いものに（ a 目がない ／ b 歯が立たない ）。
items.qr: Yoshida-san wa amai mono ni (a me ga nai / b ha ga tatanai).
items.en: Ms Yoshida can't resist anything sweet.
items.hi: योशिदा-सान मीठे की बेहद शौक़ीन हैं।
items.gu: યોશિદા-સાન મીઠાઈનાં ખૂબ શોખીન છે.

opts.en: is no match for, can't handle

items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 〜に目がない = love something so much you lose your judgement over it — food, drink or hobbies. 歯が立たない is a trap because sweets and teeth seem to go together, but the idiom means "too strong / too hard for me" (an opponent, a problem).
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 三日前にけんかして以来、二人は（ a 口を挟んで ／ b 口をきいて ）いない。
items.qr: Mikka mae ni kenka shite irai, futari wa (a kuchi o hasande / b kuchi o kiite) inai.
items.en: Since they quarrelled three days ago, the two haven't spoken to each other.
items.hi: तीन दिन पहले झगड़ा होने के बाद से दोनों में बोलचाल बंद है।
items.gu: ત્રણ દિવસ પહેલાં ઝઘડો થયો ત્યારથી બંને વચ્ચે બોલચાલ બંધ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 口をきく = talk to someone; 口をきかない／きいていない is the usual way to say "not on speaking terms" after a fight. 口を挟む is cutting into another person's conversation, which needs a third party and doesn't fit two people who have fallen out.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: マンションの建設計画に対し、近隣の住民は（ a 腕を上げて ／ b 口をそろえて ）反対した。
items.qr: Manshon no kensetsu keikaku ni taishi, kinrin no juumin wa (a ude o agete / b kuchi o soroete) hantai shita.
items.en: The local residents opposed the plan to build the apartment block with one voice.
items.hi: अपार्टमेंट बनाने की योजना का आसपास के निवासियों ने एक सुर में विरोध किया।
items.gu: એપાર્ટમેન્ટ બાંધવાની યોજનાનો આસપાસના રહેવાસીઓએ એક સૂરે વિરોધ કર્યો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 口をそろえる = many people say the same thing together: 口をそろえて反対する／ほめる. 腕を上げる is a trap for learners who picture raising arms in protest, but the idiom means "get better at something" (料理の腕を上げた). (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング③

items.q: 部長はとても（ a 頭が切れる ／ b 頭を冷やす ）人で、仕事が効率的だ。
items.qr: Buchou wa totemo (a atama ga kireru / b atama o hiyasu) hito de, shigoto ga kouritsuteki da.
items.en: Our department head is very sharp, and works efficiently.
items.hi: हमारे विभाग प्रमुख बहुत तेज़ दिमाग़ वाले हैं और उनका काम कुशल है।
items.gu: અમારા વિભાગના વડા ખૂબ તેજ દિમાગવાળા છે અને તેમનું કામ કાર્યક્ષમ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The sentence describes a permanent quality of a person (〜人で) that explains efficient work: 頭が切れる "razor-sharp mind". 頭を冷やす is an action you take once when you are angry or excited, so it can't describe what kind of person someone is.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 入院中は私のために何度も（ a 足を運んで ／ b 足を伸ばして ）くださって、ありがとうございました。
items.qr: Nyuuinchuu wa watashi no tame ni nando mo (a ashi o hakonde / b ashi o nobashite) kudasatte, arigatou gozaimashita.
items.en: Thank you for coming to see me so many times while I was in hospital.
items.hi: अस्पताल में रहते समय मेरे लिए कई बार ख़ुद चलकर आने के लिए धन्यवाद।
items.gu: હોસ્પિટલમાં હતો ત્યારે મારા માટે ઘણી વાર જાતે આવવા બદલ આભાર.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 足を運ぶ = to go somewhere on purpose, in person — and with 何度も and くださる it thanks someone for their effort in visiting. 足を伸ばす means extending a trip to a further place (ついでに隣町まで足を伸ばす), not visiting a sick person.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: ここまで来たら、（ a 腹を割って ／ b 腹をくくって ）やるしかない。
items.qr: Koko made kitara, (a hara o watte / b hara o kukutte) yaru shika nai.
items.en: Now that we've come this far, there's nothing to do but steel ourselves and go for it.
items.hi: यहाँ तक आ गए हैं तो अब मन पक्का करके करना ही होगा।
items.gu: અહીં સુધી આવી ગયા છીએ તો હવે મન મક્કમ કરીને કરવું જ પડશે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ここまで来たら〜しかない expresses resolve — there's no turning back, so 腹をくくる "brace yourself, accept the risk". 腹を割る is about honest talk and almost always goes with 話す (腹を割って話す), not やる.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 1台数千万円もする車は、私には（ a 手が届かない ／ b 手が回らない ）。
items.qr: Ichidai suusenman-en mo suru kuruma wa, watashi ni wa (a te ga todokanai / b te ga mawaranai).
items.en: A car costing tens of millions of yen is out of my reach.
items.hi: करोड़ों येन की कार मेरी पहुँच से बाहर है।
items.gu: કરોડો યેનની કાર મારી પહોંચ બહાર છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A price beyond your means = 手が届かない (高嶺の花). 手が回らない is about not having enough time or people to deal with everything (忙しくて〜まで手が回らない); it says nothing about money.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: こんなに多くの資料の整理は、一人では（ a 手に負えない ／ b 手につかない ）。
items.qr: Konna ni ooku no shiryou no seiri wa, hitori de wa (a te ni oenai / b te ni tsukanai).
items.en: Sorting out this many documents is too much for one person to handle.
items.hi: इतने सारे दस्तावेज़ों को अकेले सँभालना बस के बाहर है।
items.gu: આટલા બધા દસ્તાવેજો એકલા સંભાળવા ગજા બહાર છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 一人では "alone" points to capacity: the job is beyond what one person can manage = 手に負えない. 手につかない needs an emotional cause (心配で／うれしくて仕事が手につかない), and the subject is the task you can't focus on.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 子どもがちっとも言うことを聞かず、（ a 手を抜いている ／ b 手を焼いている ）。
items.qr: Kodomo ga chitto mo iu koto o kikazu, (a te o nuite iru / b te o yaite iru).
items.en: My child won't listen to a word I say, and I'm at my wits' end.
items.hi: बच्चा मेरी एक नहीं सुनता, मैं परेशान हो गया हूँ।
items.gu: બાળક મારું જરાય સાંભળતું નથી, હું હેરાન થઈ ગયો છું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): When someone won't do as told and you don't know how to handle them, you 手を焼く (〜に手を焼く — children, a stubborn customer). 手を抜く would mean the parent is slacking, which doesn't follow from the child not listening.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 自動車メーカー二社が（ a 手を貸して ／ b 手を組んで ）新車の開発を行うと発表した。
items.qr: Jidousha meekaa nisha ga (a te o kashite / b te o kunde) shinsha no kaihatsu o okonau to happyou shita.
items.en: Two carmakers announced that they will join forces to develop a new car.
items.hi: दो कार कंपनियों ने घोषणा की कि वे हाथ मिलाकर नई कार विकसित करेंगी।
items.gu: બે કાર કંપનીઓએ જાહેરાત કરી કે તેઓ હાથ મિલાવીને નવી કાર વિકસાવશે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Two equal parties (二社が) working together = 手を組む (提携する). 手を貸す is one side helping another (友達の引っ越しに手を貸す), so it needs a helper and a helped, and a に-object.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 小川課長は、部下に対しても丁寧に接する（ a 腰が重い ／ b 腰が低い ）人だ。
items.qr: Ogawa kachou wa, buka ni taishite mo teinei ni sessuru (a koshi ga omoi / b koshi ga hikui) hito da.
items.en: Section chief Ogawa is a humble person who is polite even to his subordinates.
items.hi: ओगावा सेक्शन चीफ़ विनम्र व्यक्ति हैं, जो अपने मातहतों से भी अदब से पेश आते हैं।
items.gu: ઓગાવા સેક્શન ચીફ નમ્ર વ્યક્તિ છે, જે પોતાના હાથ નીચેના લોકો સાથે પણ વિવેકથી વર્તે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Being polite even to people below you = 腰が低い (bowing low → modest). 腰が重い means slow to start doing something (なかなか動かない), which is a criticism and doesn't match 丁寧に接する.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 彼女は噂好きで、何にでも（ a 首をつっこんで ／ b 首をひねって ）くる。
items.qr: Kanojo wa uwasazuki de, nan ni demo (a kubi o tsukkonde / b kubi o hinette) kuru.
items.en: She loves gossip and pokes her nose into everything.
items.hi: उसे गपशप का शौक़ है और वह हर बात में टाँग अड़ाती है।
items.gu: તેને ગપસપનો શોખ છે અને તે દરેક વાતમાં માથું મારે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Someone who loves gossip gets involved in other people's business = 〜に首を突っ込む; the に of 何にでも fits it. 首をひねる is tilting your head because something is puzzling, and it isn't used with に or "everything". (The readable page-foot fragment 「9 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: 彼は、「任せてください」と（ a 顔を立てて ／ b 胸を張って ）答えた。
items.qr: Kare wa, "makasete kudasai" to (a kao o tatete / b mune o hatte) kotaeta.
items.en: "Leave it to me," he answered confidently.
items.hi: उसने सीना तानकर जवाब दिया, "मुझ पर छोड़ दीजिए।"
items.gu: તેણે છાતી કાઢીને જવાબ આપ્યો, "મારા પર છોડી દો."
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 「任せてください」 is a confident promise, said 胸を張って "chest out, with pride". 顔を立てる means acting to protect someone else's reputation (上司の顔を立てる) and needs a に／の-person — there is none here. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング④

items.q: このレストランの肉料理はどれも（ a バランス ／ b ボリューム ）がある。
items.qr: Kono resutoran no niku ryouri wa dore mo (a baransu / b boryuumu) ga aru.
items.en: The meat dishes at this restaurant all come in generous portions.
items.hi: इस रेस्टोरेंट के सभी मांसाहारी व्यंजन भरपूर मात्रा में आते हैं।
items.gu: આ રેસ્ટોરાંની બધી માંસાહારી વાનગીઓ ભરપૂર માત્રામાં આવે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Of food, ボリュームがある means "filling, generous in quantity" — a standard restaurant-review phrase. バランス goes with がいい／がとれている (栄養のバランスがいい), and どれもバランスがある is not natural Japanese.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: 日本料理は、魚や野菜を多く使っていて、（ a ヘルシー ／ b カロリー ）だと言われている。
items.qr: Nihon ryouri wa, sakana ya yasai o ooku tsukatte ite, (a herushii / b karorii) da to iwarete iru.
items.en: Japanese food uses a lot of fish and vegetables and is said to be healthy.
items.hi: जापानी भोजन में मछली और सब्ज़ियाँ ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल होती हैं, इसलिए उसे सेहतमंद माना जाता है।
items.gu: જાપાની ભોજનમાં માછલી અને શાકભાજી વધુ વપરાય છે, એટલે તેને આરોગ્યપ્રદ માનવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The blank is followed by だ, so it needs a word that describes the food: ヘルシーだ (a な-adjective). カロリー is a noun and needs an adjective: カロリーが低い. "Japanese food is calorie" doesn't make sense.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: このレストランは、接客の仕方がすべて（ a メニュー ／ b マニュアル ）で決められている。
items.qr: Kono resutoran wa, sekkyaku no shikata ga subete (a menyuu / b manyuaru) de kimerarete iru.
items.en: At this restaurant, the way staff serve customers is all laid down in a manual.
items.hi: इस रेस्टोरेंट में ग्राहकों की सेवा का हर तरीक़ा नियमावली में तय है।
items.gu: આ રેસ્ટોરાંમાં ગ્રાહકોની સેવાની દરેક રીત નિયમાવલીમાં નક્કી છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 接客の仕方 (how to serve customers) is a procedure, and procedures are set out in a マニュアル. メニュー is the trap because the setting is a restaurant, but a menu lists dishes, not how staff behave.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: お困りの際は、2階の相談（ a カウンター ／ b アカウント ）までお越しください。
items.qr: Okomari no sai wa, nikai no soudan (a kauntaa / b akaunto) made okoshi kudasai.
items.en: If you need help, please come to the help desk on the 2nd floor.
items.hi: किसी परेशानी में हों तो कृपया दूसरी मंज़िल के सहायता काउंटर पर आइए।
items.gu: કોઈ મુશ્કેલી હોય તો કૃપા કરીને બીજા માળના સહાયતા કાઉન્ટર પર આવો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): You can physically go to (お越しください) a place on the 2nd floor, so it must be the 相談カウンター (help desk). アカウント is an online or bank account — not somewhere you can walk to. The two words share sounds, which is the trap.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: こちらの商品は、今週末まで10%割引（ a キャンパス ／ b キャンペーン ）を実施中です。
items.qr: Kochira no shouhin wa, konshuumatsu made juppaasento waribiki (a kyanpasu / b kyanpeen) o jisshichuu desu.
items.en: This product is on a 10%-off promotion until this weekend.
items.hi: इस उत्पाद पर इस सप्ताहांत तक 10% छूट की योजना चल रही है।
items.gu: આ ઉત્પાદન પર આ સપ્તાહના અંત સુધી 10% વળતરની યોજના ચાલુ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 割引キャンペーンを実施する "run a discount promotion" is a fixed shop phrase. キャンパス (a university campus) only looks similar in katakana.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: 会員カードを提示すると、購入金額に応じて（ a プリント ／ b ポイント ）がたまります。
items.qr: Kaiin kaado o teiji suru to, kounyuu kingaku ni oujite (a purinto / b pointo) ga tamarimasu.
items.en: If you show your membership card, you build up points according to how much you spend.
items.hi: सदस्यता कार्ड दिखाने पर ख़रीद की रक़म के हिसाब से पॉइंट जमा होते हैं।
items.gu: સભ્યપદ કાર્ડ બતાવવાથી ખરીદીની રકમ પ્રમાણે પોઇન્ટ જમા થાય છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Loyalty schemes give ポイント, which たまる (build up) in proportion to 購入金額. プリント is a printed sheet; it can pile up on a desk, but has nothing to do with spending.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: 5月の本格的な行楽（ a シーズン ／ b シリーズ ）を迎え、山は登山客でいっぱいだ。
items.qr: Gogatsu no honkakuteki na kouraku (a shiizun / b shiriizu) o mukae, yama wa tozankyaku de ippai da.
items.en: With May's holiday season now in full swing, the mountains are packed with climbers.
items.hi: मई का असली घूमने-फिरने का मौसम आ गया है, और पहाड़ पर्वतारोहियों से भरे हैं।
items.gu: મેની ખરી ફરવાની મોસમ આવી ગઈ છે, અને પહાડો પર્વતારોહકોથી ભરેલા છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 行楽シーズン = the season for outings and trips; 〜シーズンを迎える "a season arrives" is a set phrase. シリーズ is a series of books, films or matches.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: このATMの機械は、画面を（ a タッチ ／ b スイッチ ）すると動き出します。
items.qr: Kono ee-tii-emu no kikai wa, gamen o (a tatchi / b suitchi) suru to ugokidashimasu.
items.en: This ATM starts when you touch the screen.
items.hi: यह एटीएम मशीन स्क्रीन छूने पर चालू हो जाती है।
items.gu: આ એટીએમ મશીન સ્ક્રીનને સ્પર્શ કરવાથી ચાલુ થાય છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 画面をタッチする = touch the screen (タッチパネル). スイッチ is a noun used with を入れる／を切る; 画面をスイッチする is not Japanese.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: 近年、大気汚染や食品が原因の（ a アレルギー ／ b ホームシック ）患者が増え続けている。
items.qr: Kinnen, taiki osen ya shokuhin ga gen'in no (a arerugii / b hoomushikku) kanja ga fuetsuzukete iru.
items.en: In recent years, the number of people with allergies caused by air pollution or food keeps rising.
items.hi: हाल के वर्षों में वायु प्रदूषण या भोजन से होने वाली एलर्जी के मरीज़ लगातार बढ़ रहे हैं।
items.gu: તાજેતરનાં વર્ષોમાં વાયુ પ્રદૂષણ કે ખોરાકથી થતી એલર્જીના દર્દીઓ સતત વધી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Air pollution and food cause アレルギー (from German Allergie, hence the spelling). ホームシック is missing home — not caused by pollution, and people with it aren't 患者 (patients).
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: 新メニューの開発のため、100名の（ a モーター ／ b モニター ）に実際に食べてもらい、意見を聞いた。
items.qr: Shin-menyuu no kaihatsu no tame, hyakumei no (a mootaa / b monitaa) ni jissai ni tabete morai, iken o kiita.
items.en: To develop new dishes, we had 100 test customers actually eat them and give their opinions.
items.hi: नए व्यंजन विकसित करने के लिए 100 परीक्षण-ग्राहकों से उन्हें चखवाकर उनकी राय ली गई।
items.gu: નવી વાનગીઓ વિકસાવવા માટે 100 પરીક્ષણ-ગ્રાહકોને ચખાડીને તેમનો અભિપ્રાય લેવાયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): In Japanese, モニター is also a person who tries a product and reports back (モニターを募集する). 100名の… and 意見を聞いた make it a person. モーター is a motor. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑤

items.q: この地域は、水道・電気・ガスなどの（ a インフラ ／ b インフレ ）の整備が遅れている。
items.qr: Kono chiiki wa, suidou, denki, gasu nado no (a infura / b infure) no seibi ga okurete iru.
items.en: This area is behind in developing infrastructure such as water, electricity and gas.
items.hi: यह इलाक़ा पानी, बिजली, गैस जैसे बुनियादी ढाँचे के विकास में पिछड़ा हुआ है।
items.gu: આ વિસ્તાર પાણી, વીજળી, ગેસ જેવી માળખાકીય સુવિધાઓના વિકાસમાં પાછળ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Water, power and gas are インフラ (infrastructure), and インフラの整備 "building/maintaining infrastructure" is the set phrase. インフレ (inflation) is about prices and can't be 整備される.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 結果は大切だが、結果までの（ a サクセス ／ b プロセス ）はもっと大切である。
items.qr: Kekka wa taisetsu da ga, kekka made no (a sakusesu / b purosesu) wa motto taisetsu de aru.
items.en: Results matter, but the process of getting there matters even more.
items.hi: परिणाम ज़रूरी है, पर परिणाम तक पहुँचने की प्रक्रिया उससे भी ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: પરિણામ મહત્ત્વનું છે, પણ પરિણામ સુધી પહોંચવાની પ્રક્રિયા એથીય વધુ મહત્ત્વની છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 結果までの (up to the result) = the steps that lead to it = プロセス. サクセス is itself a kind of result, so "the success up to the result" makes no sense.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: この仕事を進めるには、会社全体の（ a サポート ／ b サプライズ ）が必要だ。
items.qr: Kono shigoto o susumeru ni wa, kaisha zentai no (a sapooto / b sapuraizu) ga hitsuyou da.
items.en: To move this work forward, we need the support of the whole company.
items.hi: इस काम को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए पूरी कंपनी का सहयोग ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: આ કામ આગળ વધારવા માટે આખી કંપનીનો સહયોગ જરૂરી છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): What you need from the whole company to get work done is サポート (help, backing). サプライズ is a pleasant surprise (サプライズプレゼント) and only shares the opening sounds.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 私は自分の仕事に（ a プライド ／ b ブランド ）を持っている。
items.qr: Watashi wa jibun no shigoto ni (a puraido / b burando) o motte iru.
items.en: I take pride in my work.
items.hi: मुझे अपने काम पर गर्व है।
items.gu: મને મારા કામ પર ગર્વ છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 〜にプライドを持つ = take pride in something (same as 誇りを持つ). ブランド is a brand name or label (ブランドのバッグ); you don't "hold a brand in your work".
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 明日は気楽な集まりなので、（ a リラックス ／ b カジュアル ）な服装で来てください。
items.qr: Ashita wa kiraku na atsumari na node, (a rirakkusu / b kajuaru) na fukusou de kite kudasai.
items.en: Tomorrow is an informal get-together, so please come in casual clothes.
items.hi: कल की बैठक अनौपचारिक है, इसलिए कृपया साधारण कपड़ों में आइए।
items.gu: કાલનું મિલન અનૌપચારિક છે, એટલે કૃપા કરીને સાદાં કપડાંમાં આવો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Clothes are described as カジュアルな服装 (⇔ フォーマルな服装). リラックス is a noun/する-verb — リラックスした雰囲気 is fine, but リラックスな服装 is not Japanese. The な after the blank decides it.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 面接では、自分の長所をうまく（ a アピール ／ b アプローチ ）できなかった。
items.qr: Mensetsu de wa, jibun no chousho o umaku (a apiiru / b apuroochi) dekinakatta.
items.en: In the interview I couldn't get my strengths across well.
items.hi: इंटरव्यू में मैं अपनी ख़ूबियाँ ठीक से नहीं दिखा पाया।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરવ્યૂમાં હું મારી ખૂબીઓ બરાબર બતાવી ન શક્યો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): In Japanese, アピールする means presenting your good points to others — the key word in job interviews (自己アピール). アプローチ is approaching a problem or a person (彼女にアプローチする); 長所をアプローチする doesn't work.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: この新型車の開発（ a コンセプト ／ b コンセント ）は、「環境にやさしい」ということです。
items.qr: Kono shingatasha no kaihatsu (a konseputo / b konsento) wa, "kankyou ni yasashii" to iu koto desu.
items.en: The development concept for this new car is "environmentally friendly".
items.hi: इस नई कार के विकास की अवधारणा है "पर्यावरण के अनुकूल"।
items.gu: આ નવી કારના વિકાસની સંકલ્પના છે "પર્યાવરણને અનુકૂળ".
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The guiding idea behind a product is its コンセプト (開発コンセプト). コンセント, one sound away, is Japanese for an electrical wall socket (not "consent").
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 太陽光や風力を利用した自然（ a エコロジー ／ b エネルギー ）の活用が注目を集めている。
items.qr: Taiyoukou ya fuuryoku o riyou shita shizen (a ekorojii / b enerugii) no katsuyou ga chuumoku o atsumete iru.
items.en: The use of natural energy from sunlight and wind is attracting attention.
items.hi: सूरज की रोशनी और हवा से मिलने वाली प्राकृतिक ऊर्जा का उपयोग लोगों का ध्यान खींच रहा है।
items.gu: સૂર્યપ્રકાશ અને પવનથી મળતી કુદરતી ઊર્જાનો ઉપયોગ લોકોનું ધ્યાન ખેંચી રહ્યો છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Sun and wind are sources of 自然エネルギー (renewable energy), which you can 活用 (put to use). エコロジー is the trap: it is on-theme, but it is a science or way of thinking, not something generated from sunlight.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: ある大学生の4年間を追った（ a アナウンサー ／ b ドキュメンタリー ）番組が話題になった。
items.qr: Aru daigakusei no yonenkan o otta (a anaunsaa / b dokyumentarii) bangumi ga wadai ni natta.
items.en: A documentary that followed a university student over four years became a talking point.
items.hi: एक विश्वविद्यालय छात्र के चार सालों को दर्ज करने वाला वृत्तचित्र कार्यक्रम चर्चा का विषय बन गया।
items.gu: એક યુનિવર્સિટી વિદ્યાર્થીનાં ચાર વર્ષને આવરી લેતો દસ્તાવેજી કાર્યક્રમ ચર્ચાનો વિષય બન્યો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): A programme that 追う (follows) real people over time is a ドキュメンタリー番組. アナウンサー is a person who reads the news, not a type of programme. (The readable page-foot fragment 「9 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 昔は手紙・電話・電報のみだった通信（ a メディア ／ b アイディア ）が、IT技術の進歩とともに多様化してきた。
items.qr: Mukashi wa tegami, denwa, denpou nomi datta tsuushin (a media / b aidia) ga, ai-tii gijutsu no shinpo to tomo ni tayouka shite kita.
items.en: Means of communication, once limited to letters, phone and telegram, have diversified as IT has advanced.
items.hi: संचार के माध्यम, जो पहले सिर्फ़ चिट्ठी, फ़ोन और तार तक सीमित थे, आईटी की प्रगति के साथ विविध हो गए हैं।
items.gu: સંચારનાં માધ્યમો, જે પહેલાં માત્ર પત્ર, ફોન અને તાર સુધી સીમિત હતાં, આઇટીની પ્રગતિ સાથે વૈવિધ્યસભર બન્યાં છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Letters, telephone and telegrams are all 通信メディア (means of communication). アイディア rhymes with メディア, which is the only reason it is there. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑥

items.q: 数年ぶりに会った彼女は（ a かりかり ／ b がりがり ）にやせていた。
items.qr: Suunenburi ni atta kanojo wa (a karikari / b garigari) ni yasete ita.
items.en: When I saw her for the first time in years, she had become skin and bones.
items.hi: कई साल बाद मिली तो वह बिल्कुल हड्डियों का ढाँचा हो गई थी।
items.gu: ઘણાં વર્ષે મળી ત્યારે તે સાવ હાડપિંજર જેવી પાતળી થઈ ગઈ હતી.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): がりがりにやせる is the set phrase for being painfully thin. かりかり describes crisp food (かりかりのベーコン) or an irritable mood (試験前でかりかりしている), never body shape.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: 彼は（ a こそこそ ／ b ごそごそ ）逃げるように出ていった。
items.qr: Kare wa (a kosokoso / b gosogoso) nigeru you ni dete itta.
items.en: He slipped out as if sneaking away.
items.hi: वह चोरी-छिपे भागने की तरह बाहर निकल गया।
items.gu: તે છાનુંમાનું ભાગતો હોય એમ બહાર નીકળી ગયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): こそこそ = doing something secretly so others won't notice — it goes naturally with 逃げる. ごそごそ is the sound of rummaging (引き出しをごそごそ探す) and has no sense of hiding.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: あの人は言うことが（ a ころころ ／ b ごろごろ ）変わる。
items.qr: Ano hito wa iu koto ga (a korokoro / b gorogoro) kawaru.
items.en: What that person says keeps changing.
items.hi: उस व्यक्ति की बातें बार-बार बदलती रहती हैं।
items.gu: તે વ્યક્તિની વાતો વારેઘડીએ બદલાતી રહે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ころころ変わる = (opinions, plans, a story) change easily and often — from something light rolling about. ごろごろ is heavy: lazing about, thunder, or lots of big things lying around.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: 公演開始前の会場は（ a さわさわ ／ b ざわざわ ）していた。
items.qr: Kouen kaishi mae no kaijou wa (a sawasawa / b zawazawa) shite ita.
items.en: Before the performance started, the hall was buzzing with voices.
items.hi: प्रदर्शन शुरू होने से पहले हॉल में शोरगुल था।
items.gu: કાર્યક્રમ શરૂ થતાં પહેલાં હૉલમાં કોલાહલ હતો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ざわざわする = many people talking at once, a restless crowd noise. さわさわ is the soft sound of wind through leaves — a quiet, pleasant sound, not a full hall.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: 雨が続いたせいか、部屋が（ a しとしと ／ b じとじと ）して気持ちが悪い。
items.qr: Ame ga tsuzuita sei ka, heya ga (a shitoshito / b jitojito) shite kimochi ga warui.
items.en: Maybe because of all the rain, the room feels damp and unpleasant.
items.hi: शायद लगातार बारिश की वजह से कमरे में सीलन है और बुरा लगता है।
items.gu: કદાચ સતત વરસાદને કારણે ઓરડો ભેજવાળો છે અને ખરાબ લાગે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): The subject is 部屋 and the feeling is 気持ちが悪い, so it must be the unpleasant dampness: じとじと. しとしと describes the rain itself falling gently (雨がしとしと降る) — the trap, since the sentence mentions rain.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: 日に焼けた肌が（ a ひりひり ／ b びりびり ）痛い。
items.qr: Hi ni yaketa hada ga (a hirihiri / b biribiri) itai.
items.en: My sunburnt skin stings.
items.hi: धूप से झुलसी त्वचा में जलन हो रही है।
items.gu: તડકાથી બળેલી ચામડીમાં બળતરા થાય છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ひりひり = the burning sting of a burn, sunburn, a scrape or spicy food. びりびり is an electric shock (電気がびりびりくる) or paper being torn — not a sunburn.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: Lサイズだと私には大きすぎて（ a ふかふか ／ b ぶかぶか ）だ。
items.qr: Eru saizu da to watashi ni wa ookisugite (a fukafuka / b bukabuka) da.
items.en: A size L is too big for me — it's baggy.
items.hi: L साइज़ मेरे लिए बहुत बड़ा है, एकदम ढीला है।
items.gu: L સાઇઝ મારા માટે ખૂબ મોટી છે, સાવ ઢીલી છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 大きすぎて gives it away: ぶかぶか = clothes or shoes too large for you (≈ だぶだぶ, 第17回 問題2 Q3). ふかふか is soft and springy — bread, a futon, a sofa.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: （ a へらへら ／ b ぺらぺら ）笑っていないで、真剣に考えてください。
items.qr: (a herahera / b perapera) waratte inaide, shinken ni kangaete kudasai.
items.en: Stop grinning like that and think about it seriously.
items.hi: यूँ बेवजह हँसना बंद करो और गंभीरता से सोचो।
items.gu: આમ વગર કારણે હસવાનું બંધ કરો અને ગંભીરતાથી વિચારો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): へらへら笑う = laugh in a vague, unserious way — exactly what 真剣に考えて is contrasting. ぺらぺら goes with talking (ぺらぺらしゃべる) or language skill (英語がぺらぺら), not with 笑う.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: （ a もこもこ ／ b もごもご ）しゃべっているから、よく聞こえません。
items.qr: (a mokomoko / b mogomogo) shabette iru kara, yoku kikoemasen.
items.en: You're mumbling, so I can't hear you properly.
items.hi: तुम बुदबुदा रहे हो, इसलिए ठीक से सुनाई नहीं दे रहा।
items.gu: તમે ગણગણો છો, એટલે બરાબર સંભળાતું નથી.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): もごもご = speaking unclearly, as if with your mouth full — which is why you can't hear. もこもこ describes puffy, bulging things (もこもこのダウンジャケット), not speech.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: 今は成績がトップでも、（ a ほやほや ／ b ぼやぼや ）していると、すぐにみんなに追い抜かれますよ。
items.qr: Ima wa seiseki ga toppu demo, (a hoyahoya / b boyaboya) shite iru to, sugu ni minna ni oinukaremasu yo.
items.en: Even if your grades are top now, if you slack off, everyone will soon overtake you.
items.hi: अभी तुम्हारे अंक सबसे ऊपर हैं, पर लापरवाही करोगे तो सब जल्दी आगे निकल जाएँगे।
items.gu: હાલ તમારા ગુણ સૌથી ઉપર છે, પણ બેદરકારી રાખશો તો બધા ઝડપથી આગળ નીકળી જશે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ぼやぼやする = be careless and slow, not paying attention — the warning before 追い抜かれる. ほやほや means fresh and new (焼きたてのほやほや, 新婚ほやほや). (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑦

items.q: ミルクをやったら、子犬は（ a うんうん ／ b くんくん ）とにおいをかいだ。
items.qr: Miruku o yattara, koinu wa (a un'un / b kunkun) to nioi o kaida.
items.en: When I gave the puppy some milk, it sniffed at it.
items.hi: मैंने पिल्ले को दूध दिया तो उसने सूँ-सूँ करके सूँघा।
items.gu: મેં ગલૂડિયાને દૂધ આપ્યું તો તેણે સૂં-સૂં કરીને સૂંઘ્યું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): くんくん is the sound/action of sniffing, and goes with においをかぐ. うんうん is nodding agreement (うんうんとうなずく) or groaning in pain.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: 焼肉を食べすぎて、お腹が（ a ぱんぱん ／ b ぽんぽん ）だ。
items.qr: Yakiniku o tabesugite, onaka ga (a panpan / b ponpon) da.
items.en: I ate too much yakiniku — my stomach is stuffed.
items.hi: याकिनिकु ज़्यादा खा लिया, पेट फूलकर ठसाठस हो गया है।
items.gu: યાકિનિકુ વધુ ખાઈ લીધું, પેટ ઠાંસોઠાંસ ભરાઈ ગયું છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ぱんぱん = filled to bursting: お腹／かばんがぱんぱん. ぽんぽん is a baby word for "tummy" (お腹 itself), not its state, and also means "rapidly, bluntly" (ぽんぽん言う), so お腹がぽんぽんだ doesn't work.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: 私が嘘をつくと、いつもは優しい母が（ a かんかん ／ b たんたん ）に怒った。
items.qr: Watashi ga uso o tsuku to, itsumo wa yasashii haha ga (a kankan / b tantan) ni okotta.
items.en: When I lied, my usually gentle mother was furious.
items.hi: जब मैंने झूठ बोला तो हमेशा नरम रहने वाली माँ आग-बबूला हो गईं।
items.gu: મેં જૂઠું બોલ્યું ત્યારે હંમેશાં નરમ રહેતી મા લાલચોળ ગુસ્સે થઈ ગઈ.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): かんかんに怒る = be absolutely furious (the contrast with いつもは優しい). たんたん (淡々と) is the opposite — calm and unemotional — and takes と, not に.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: 高校生になって、弟は背が（ a ごんごん ／ b ぐんぐん ）伸びた。
items.qr: Koukousei ni natte, otouto wa se ga (a gongon / b gungun) nobita.
items.en: Since starting high school, my little brother has shot up in height.
items.hi: हाई स्कूल में आने के बाद मेरे छोटे भाई का क़द तेज़ी से बढ़ा।
items.gu: હાઈસ્કૂલમાં આવ્યા પછી મારા નાના ભાઈની ઊંચાઈ ઝડપથી વધી.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ぐんぐん = steadily and fast — growth, improvement, speed (背がぐんぐん伸びる, 成績がぐんぐん上がる). ごんごん is only a heavy knocking sound.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: 頭が痛い。（ a ぶんぶん ／ b がんがん ）する。
items.qr: Atama ga itai. (a bunbun / b gangan) suru.
items.en: I have a headache. It's pounding.
items.hi: सिर में दर्द है। फटा जा रहा है।
items.gu: માથું દુખે છે. ફાટી પડે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): 頭ががんがんする = a hammering headache (also loud music, or working all-out). ぶんぶん is bees buzzing or swinging a bat hard — not pain.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: 太陽が（ a さんさん ／ b しんしん ）と輝く夏の午後だった。
items.qr: Taiyou ga (a sansan / b shinshin) to kagayaku natsu no gogo datta.
items.en: It was a summer afternoon with the sun shining brilliantly.
items.hi: वह गर्मियों की दोपहर थी, सूरज चमचमा रहा था।
items.gu: તે ઉનાળાની બપોર હતી, સૂરજ ઝગમગતો હતો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): さんさん (燦々) と輝く／降り注ぐ is the fixed image of bright sunshine. しんしん belongs to silent snow and deep winter nights — the opposite season.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: なぐられた頬が（ a じんじん ／ b びんびん ）と痛む。
items.qr: Nagurareta hoo ga (a jinjin / b binbin) to itamu.
items.en: The cheek where I was hit is throbbing with pain.
items.hi: जहाँ मुक्का लगा था वह गाल टीस मार रहा है।
items.gu: જ્યાં મુક્કો વાગ્યો હતો તે ગાલ ટીસ મારે છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): じんじん = a dull, spreading, throbbing pain or numbness (after a blow, cold, or sitting too long). びんびん is something felt intensely — 気持ちがびんびん伝わる, 音がびんびん響く — not pain.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: その男の子はおもちゃを買ってもらえず、店の前で（ a まんまん ／ b わんわん ）泣いていた。
items.qr: Sono otoko no ko wa omocha o katte moraezu, mise no mae de (a manman / b wanwan) naite ita.
items.en: The boy didn't get the toy he wanted and was bawling in front of the shop.
items.hi: उस लड़के को खिलौना नहीं मिला तो वह दुकान के सामने दहाड़ें मारकर रो रहा था।
items.gu: તે છોકરાને રમકડું ન મળ્યું એટલે દુકાન સામે પોક મૂકીને રડતો હતો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): わんわん泣く = cry loudly like a child (also a dog's bark). まんまん is 満々 "full of" (自信満々, やる気満々) and cannot describe crying.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: あんな大事故にあったのに、もう（ a ぴんぴん ／ b ぷんぷん ）している。
items.qr: Anna daijiko ni atta noni, mou (a pinpin / b punpun) shite iru.
items.en: Despite being in such a serious accident, he's already fighting fit.
items.hi: इतनी बड़ी दुर्घटना के बावजूद वह अभी से भला-चंगा है।
items.gu: આટલા મોટા અકસ્માત છતાં તે અત્યારથી જ તંદુરસ્ત છે.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ぴんぴんしている = lively and perfectly healthy, often surprisingly so (のに). ぷんぷん is sulky anger or a strong smell. (The readable page-foot fragment 「9 a」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: みんなが止めるのも聞かず、彼は一人で（ a ばんばん ／ b ずんずん ）歩いていった。
items.qr: Minna ga tomeru no mo kikazu, kare wa hitori de (a banban / b zunzun) aruite itta.
items.en: Ignoring everyone who tried to stop him, he strode off on his own.
items.hi: सबके रोकने के बावजूद वह अकेला तेज़ क़दमों से आगे बढ़ता चला गया।
items.gu: બધાના રોકવા છતાં તે એકલો ઝડપી પગલે આગળ વધતો ગયો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ずんずん歩く／進む = keep moving forward quickly and without hesitation. ばんばん is loud banging or doing something boldly and repeatedly (ばんばん意見を言う), not walking. (The readable page-foot fragment 「10 b」 agrees.)
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑧

items.q: つい（ a はっと ／ b かっと ）なって、机をたたいてしまった。
items.qr: Tsui (a hatto / b katto) natte, tsukue o tataite shimatta.
items.en: I lost my temper and banged the desk before I knew it.
items.hi: मैं अचानक भड़क गया और मेज़ पर हाथ पटक दिया।
items.gu: હું અચાનક ભડકી ગયો અને ટેબલ પર હાથ પછાડી દીધો.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): かっとなる = flare up in sudden anger — the reason you bang the desk. はっとする is a sudden realization or start (はっと気づく), and it takes する, not なる.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑨

items.q: その子は怒ったような顔で（ a きっと ／ b ざっと ）私をにらんだ。
items.qr: Sono ko wa okotta you na kao de (a kitto / b zatto) watashi o niranda.
items.en: The child glared at me sharply with an angry look.
items.hi: उस बच्चे ने ग़ुस्से भरे चेहरे से मुझे तीखी नज़र से घूरा।
items.gu: તે બાળકે ગુસ્સાભર્યા ચહેરે મને તીખી નજરે ઘૂર્યું.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): Besides "surely", きっと describes a sharp, severe look: きっとにらむ／きっと見すえる. ざっと is a quick rough pass (ざっと目を通す, ざっと100人) — not a glare.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑨

items.q: 涙が出そうになるのを（ a ぐっと ／ b ぱっと ）こらえた。
items.qr: Namida ga desou ni naru no o (a gutto / b patto) koraeta.
items.en: I held back the tears that were about to come.
items.hi: उमड़ते आँसुओं को मैंने कसकर रोक लिया।
items.gu: ઊભરાતાં આંસુને મેં મક્કમતાથી રોકી રાખ્યાં.
items.why: Why (worked out for this site — not from an official key): ぐっとこらえる／我慢する = hold something back with inner effort. ぱっと is sudden and open (ぱっと明るくなる) — the opposite of holding in.
items.unit: パワードリル 集中トレーニング⑨

items.q: 彼女は私が隣に座ると、（ a ほっと ／ b さっと ）席を立ってしまった。
